title: eriosema edule
intro: Eriosema edule, commonly known as the wild kidney bean, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family native to tropical Africa. It is valued for its culinary, medicinal, and therapeutic properties, offering several health benefits such as improving kidney function and reducing inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions like kidney stones and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Eriosema edule include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
